craft_evidence.owned: no: none claimed; Stewardship page links the brand's manufacturing-partner list on Open Supply Hub (contributor 8633, 30 facilities on 19 Oct 2026)
craft_evidence.makers: not on product pages; brand-level list of 30 facilities on Open Supply Hub, linked from the Stewardship page
craft_evidence.mills: 1 of 99 styles names a cloth mill (Kaihara, Slipstone Japanese Denim Shirt); Allied Feather + Down named as down supplier (Colter Down Jacket); otherwise licensed fabric brands (Polartec, Pertex, GORE-TEX, Thermore)
craft_evidence.madein: 100% (99/99 clothing PDPs state Made in: Vietnam, China, Cambodia, El Salvador, Indonesia)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: "Since 2011 ... in our hometown of Jackson, WY" (About page)
craft_evidence.process: fabric specification only: denier, weight g/m2, membrane waterproofness/breathability, DWR chemistry (PFAS-free) on every PDP; no making process published
craft_evidence.reasoning: Stio owns no factory and names no maker on product pages, but publishes its full manufacturing-partner list (30 facilities on Open Supply Hub, linked from its Stewardship page) and states country of origin on every PDP. Mills are named only where a licensed fabric is used and once for Kaihara denim. That is "names its makers, owns nothing": 3, at the low edge; a 2 is defensible if the list must be on product pages.
